create_subclass_action_representation_mo: create a subclass of ActionRepresentationModule implementing max_number_actions, representation_dim, forward, and compare
implement_forward_method: implement the forward method in a subclass to transform input tensors into action representations
implement_compare_method: implement the compare method to check equality between two action representation module instances
